action.objective: Verify Bxe7 (g5e7), the reserved broad-search suggestion, as the candidate to commit.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search made g5e7 the sole exact-scored leader (89) without producing commit_ready moves; it trades the dark-squared bishop for Black's e7 bishop, avoiding Bg5 being harassed and keeping a solid structure. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 is required before any commit.
